title: RULES for the 24-Hour Laundromat After Midnight #shorts
description_hook: It's the only laundromat open after midnight. One light flickers, and one dryer is already running. A work of fiction.

lines.text: NEVER OPEN A DRYER YOU DIDN'T START
lines.say: You walk into the only laundromat open after midnight. Rule one: never open a dryer you didn't start.
lines.img: an empty laundromat at night, long rows of front-loading washers under harsh fluorescent tubes, one dryer at the end spinning with a soft glow, plastic chairs along the wall

lines.text: IF EVERY MACHINE STOPS, DON'T MOVE
lines.say: Rule two. If every machine stops at once, don't move.
lines.img: a silent row of round washing machine doors in a dim laundromat, every drum perfectly still, one fluorescent tube overhead flickering half dark

lines.say: Rule three. The change machine gives one coin too many. Don't spend it.
lines.img: close-up of a metal coin tray on a wall-mounted change machine in a laundromat at night, a small pile of coins catching cold light, blurred machines behind

lines.text: DON'T FOLD CLOTHES YOU DON'T RECOGNIZE
lines.say: Rule four. Don't fold clothes you don't recognize.
lines.img: a white folding table in an empty laundromat holding a neat warm pile of unfamiliar clothes, a plastic basket beside it, flickering light above

lines.text: KEEP YOUR BACK TO THE WINDOW
lines.say: Rule five. Keep your back to the window. Whatever is tapping, it isn't rain.
lines.img: a large laundromat window at night looking out on a dark empty street, a single streetlight, faint smudges on the glass, a plastic chair facing away from it

lines.say: Then your dryer stops. Inside are the clothes you're wearing. You never started this one. Start again.
lines.img: an open dryer door in a dim laundromat, folded clothes tumbling out identical to a jacket hanging on a nearby chair, the drum glowing warm, no one in sight

loop_back: The last line reveals the viewer opened a dryer they didn't start, breaking rule one, so they must start again from rule one.

gumi.say: So. Are you sure you started that dryer?
